encoding: compact JSON.stringify(collection) followed by one LF; UTF-8 bytes
draftSyntax: well-formed Unicode; unfinished, empty or multi-block Markdown allowed; no normalization
baseSyntax: exact supported Markdown paragraph; raw digest and literary version both checked

retention.overflow: reject without changing the previous collection
retention.replace: explicit action with exact expected prior checkpoint digest
retention.discard: explicit action with exact expected prior checkpoint digest
retention.history: checkpoint replacement/discard affects only this unreviewed draft; immutable proposals, decisions and source-resume history remain

writerRequirements.destination: existing restricted store outside every Git checkout on the authorized local host
writerRequirements.repositoryBinding: existing workspace realpath binding; no client-selected path
writerRequirements.unsafeEntries: reject symlink, hard link, nonregular or permissive entries
writerRequirements.transaction: exclusive writer lock and same-directory atomic replacement; unresolved lock blocks writes
writerRequirements.missingConfiguration: fail closed; no browser, checkout or public fallback
writerRequirements.powerLossDurability: not supplied by this preparatory contract
writerRequirements.sourceScope: existing exact source/version/action/destination grant; schema and compatible context supply no new permission

recovery.load: explicit selected-entity inspection; never automatic restore
recovery.current: exact target, basis, revision, source version, working version, raw base and private-operation binding
recovery.stale: retained comparison only; no automatic rebase or application
recovery.unavailable: retained inspection only; source cannot be substituted
recovery.newerTextarea: retain; explicit restore cannot overwrite intervening typing
recovery.application: separate fresh proposal, exact diff and explicit private decision

privacy.payload: only the strict selected-paragraph checkpoint fields; no whole source, issue bodies, chat, credentials, provider or approval fields
privacy.baseCopy: only the exact paragraph needed for before/draft comparison
privacy.outputs: neutral status/reason/count/size only; no payload or private fingerprints in public logs, receipts or issue handoffs
